statement.zh: Petrie《Abydos》第一部分（EEF Memoir 22, 1902）正式公布阿拜多斯神庙区及相关发掘，与《王陵》卷形成互补的一手记录。
statement.en: Petrie’s Abydos Part I (EEF Memoir 22, 1902) formally publishes temenos-area and related Abydos excavations, complementary to the Royal Tombs volumes.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-22; fact claims cite registered sources only.
